# Files icon attribution

`../files-icons.slint` adapts the NavBack, NavForward, NavUp, Refresh, Cut,
Copy, Paste, Rename and Delete geometry from Files Community:

- Source: https://github.com/files-community/Files/blob/c6c05c6cc84137ed554c28b2b6521c3a9ae4b049/src/Files.App.Controls/ThemedIcon/Styles/Icons.Common.xaml
- Copyright (c) Files Community; MIT License, as stated in that source file.
- Full license: [FILES-ICONS-LICENSE.txt](FILES-ICONS-LICENSE.txt).
- Changes: converted XAML layers to Slint Paths, mapped theme colors and sized
  the glyphs to 18 logical pixels. Navigation uses the outline geometry.

Include this notice and the full license with binary/source distributions that
contain these icons. No Files branding, fonts, Shell implementation or other
third-party dependencies were imported. This notice covers these specific icons;
it does not assign a license to all resources in the upstream repository.
